instrument: Hawaii County Bill 170 (zoning code amendment, data centers vs data processing facilities)
summary: Would distinguish industrial-scale data centers from standard data processing facilities in the county zoning code to close a loophole. The Windward Planning Commission deferred action to October; commissioners preferred a limit based on electrical demand over floor area.

source.citation: Honolulu Star-Advertiser, Sept 9, 2026; West Hawaii Today, July 8 and Sept 6, 2026

notes: Planning director: no data center has sought a permit; warned a county ban could push developers to state land-use approval in the agricultural district.
